summary.title: Model picker crash and loading fixes
changes: Opening the OpenRouter model picker no longer crashes or freezes.
The Add Model button shows a loading spinner and is disabled while models load.
The picker shows a loading indicator or error message and presents a scrollable list of models.
Duplicate or blank models are removed so the catalog list is cleaner.
Tapping Cancel or selecting a model now reliably closes the picker and favorite buttons are easier to tap.
